# mxroute_email_usage (Data Source)

Read account reporting. Values refresh hourly upstream, may be stale, and are computed only; they never cause configuration writes. All results are scoped to the provider's effective account. Unavailable/malformed values are errors, never invented zero values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_email_usage" "account" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) Per-email storage in the server's largest-first order; empty lists remain empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `username` (String) Server-reported effective account username.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `email_address` (String) Mailbox email address.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Mailbox storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.
- `updated_at` (String) Upstream hourly snapshot date-time, preserved exactly.
